name: Baltimore Black Slope 1832
foundry: Baltimore Type Foundry; F. Lucas, Jr., agent
description: Backslanted Roman display letters with curled capitals, ball terminals and a distinct historical lowercase.
observed: Observed characters: $0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXabcdefghijlmnopqrstuvxæ. English Black Slope, one-based PDF page 81 (archive leaf 80), an unnumbered leaf of the 1832 Baltimore specimen. Both cases and the lining figures are sampled from this impression. Additional directly traced impressions supply YZkwyz. Exact editions, pages, crops, scale anchors and cleanup are recorded in source/tracing.json and reference/specimen-restoration-sources.json.
reconstructed: All letters and figures are observed across the Baltimore and Boston 1832 showings. Punctuation other than $ is new MIT project work. Both the backslant and lowercase are retained. Digital spacing and correction of the tilted baseline are new; the historical word Black here is not a claim of blackletter.
